_comment: CROWD7 — Riamede site-wide loader route table.
The v4 loader is pasted ONCE into Wix (Settings -> Custom Code, All Pages, Body-end).
It fetches THIS file on every page load and decides whether it owns the page.
2. Drop an empty Embed Code block on the Wix page where the content should go,
and hide the old elements by hand (the house pattern — display, don't replace).
3. Add a route entry below. git push. Done — the loader is never re-pasted.
path        required. Wix page pathname, lowercase, no trailing slash. '/' = home.
slug        required. Folder + filename under website-pages/.
anchorHash  optional. Substring of the target Embed block's filesusr.com iframe src.
ONLY needed when a page carries MORE THAN ONE Wix HTML embed — with a
single embed the loader finds it unambiguously. If a page has several
and no anchorHash is given, the loader refuses to guess and does nothing.
enabled     optional, default true. Set false to switch a page off without deleting
the entry — instant rollback, no Wix login needed.
